q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an adult diaper?
title: Adult diaper carbon footprint per piece
short: Weigh the fluff pulp, superabsorbent polymer, non-wovens, backsheet and elastics per piece and multiply by supplier figures. Add converting line energy, then divide the plant's energy by pieces made.
audience: Adult diaper and incontinence product makers

ul: Non-woven top sheet and PE backsheet.
Laminating layers on the converting line.

p: Report per piece by size and weight. Pulp and superabsorbent usually make up most of the figure.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 56,800 / 2,000,000 = 0.0284 kg CO2 per piece
Add pulp, superabsorbent and non-wovens for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
